stance_rationale: Forge package cannot be approved because mandatory forge-verification artifacts are missing or non-reproducible: no hash audit, no target weights.csv, no requested stage artifact dirs, no lockbox/OOS charts, no target 5-spec Harvey regression, and no reproducible artifact for the V6 post-hoc SR claim. The package also admits 37 searched variants while relying on N=5 DSR framing for the primary defensibility claim.

critical_concerns.description: Pure Function v6.1 R12 is not auditable: forge_package_draft.json has no hash_audit field and no pre/post md5 evidence for alpha/risk/optimization packages, so the claims of read-only alpha lineage and unchanged packages are unverified.

The requested audit artifacts are absent: qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-H20260513_001, stage_artifacts/WT_H20260513_001, qepm/mailbox/worktask/WT-H20260513_001/weights.csv, target alpha_scores.parquet, and target covariance.parquet do not exist. This blocks the required schedule, alpha time-series, and PSD/condition-number checks.

The V6 post-hoc SR 2.0237 claim is not reproducible from run_layer5_R05_overlay.R or saved output artifacts: the script computes only V1-V5, and output contains grid_extended_regime_only.csv but no ultra-fine V6 grid artifact. Handoff package therefore includes performance claims outside the reproducible harness.

DSR penalty is inconsistent: the package admits total variants searched = 37, but still frames V2 as DSR PASS at N=5 and only reports V6 failure at N>=21/N=37. Baseline DSR penalty parity is not demonstrated in executable artifacts.

Required Harvey 5-spec regression is absent for the forge target: no CAPM, Carhart-3, Carhart-4, FF5, and FF6 set with t_NW, alpha_monthly, and DSR is present. The nearby harvey_5spec.csv is five IC variants, not the mandated factor-regression set.
Turnover audit uses sum(|delta beta|) * 12 / n without the RF-F7 round-trip x2 check. Reported incremental turnover therefore understates the role-prompt turnover definition.

Lockbox/OOS visual verification cannot be performed: output has no equity_curve.png, annual_returns.png, oos_zoom_chart.png, or scenario_comparison.png, so lockbox marker continuity and strategy line visibility are not auditable.

AX-001 v2 failure is rationalized as N/A pure overlay despite the package's own strict check showing all variants fail CRISIS/CAUTION SR > 0. Pure overlay classification may be valid only if separately adjudicated, not assumed from precedent.

Nearest available source covariance stage_artifacts/WT_D20260512_003/covariance.parquet is PSD but condition number is 153.919, exceeding the requested cond <= 100 post-shrink threshold; the requested target covariance artifact is missing entirely.

supporting_arguments: Source alpha tables are time-series, not single snapshots: WT_D20260425_010 alpha_scores and WT_D20260512_003 alpha_scores_new both have 268 dates from 2004-01-01 to 2026-04-01.

period_returns_layer5.csv and nav_layer5_variants.csv cover 267 months from 2004-02 to 2026-04, so return-path coverage exists even though the mandated weights.csv/monthly_returns.parquet artifacts are absent.
Parent covariance WT_D20260425_010 is PSD with condition number 24.34, but the R05 source covariance condition number is 153.92 and the target covariance file requested by the task is missing.
The package correctly discloses that V6 is post-hoc and not DSR-defensible at N>=21, but that disclosure does not substitute for reproducible artifacts or consistent DSR accounting.
unresolved_disputes: No alpha_package, risk_package, optimization_package, or challenge_note files were present under WT-H20260513_001, preventing the requested 3-agent context audit.
No target weights.csv exists, so final monthly holdings, max_names, per-name bounds, and schedule-level scalar multiplication cannot be independently verified.
No hash audit exists to prove alpha/risk/optimization packages were unchanged start-to-end.
No lockbox equity curve or OOS zoom chart exists to verify post-2024-01-23 continuity visually.
V6 ultra-fine grid and DSR calculation artifacts are not saved, despite being included in the package narrative.
weakest_assumption: The weakest assumption is that V2 remains statistically defensible under an N=5 DSR penalty after the same forge process admits 37 searched variants and includes a non-reproducible V6 post-hoc SR 2.0237 claim.
rebuttal_required: Provide pre/post md5 hash_audit for alpha_package, risk_package, and optimization_package.
Provide WT-H20260513_001 weights.csv with >=60 as_of_dates, monthly_returns.parquet, and final holdings sufficient to verify max_names and weight bounds.
Provide reproducible V6/ultra-grid artifacts or remove all V6 performance and DSR claims from the forge package.
Recompute DSR with total candidates_tried = 37 and apply the same penalty basis to baseline and candidate variants.
Provide CAPM, Carhart-3, Carhart-4, FF5, and FF6 regressions with t_NW, alpha_monthly, and DSR for the target return stream.
Regenerate equity_curve.png with lockbox marker and visible post-lockbox strategy line plus annual_returns.png and oos_zoom_chart.png.
Recompute turnover with the RF-F7 round-trip x2 convention or explicitly obtain mandate approval for one-way scalar turnover reporting.
Resolve AX-001 v2 classification: either enforce the strict CRISIS/CAUTION conditional test or provide a judge-level ruling that pure cash overlay is exempt for this WT.

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: Return-series coverage exists, but AX-008 cannot pass because the forge package lacks mandatory independent artifacts for hash integrity, weights schedule, target covariance, lockbox charts, 5-spec regression, and V6 reproducibility.
